div.h3: Every transport, one view. Blue = HTTP · Violet = SLIM/MLS · Orange = A2A over HTTPS

text.tspan: • MLS covers one hop only, hub to SLIM node. The node forwards ciphertext and never reads it.
• Every other line on this page is plain HTTP or HTTPS, terminated at the hub. The hub holds the group key and reads plaintext; that is how cognition (conductor, synthesizer, persister) works at all.
• So this is not end-to-end encryption from the hub, for a spoke or for a bridged A2A agent.
